mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_foundation_navigation_nodes(owner_key,tenant_id,code,parent_code,title,route_key,sort_order,enabled,created_by,updated_by) SELECT #{owner},CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint),code,parent_code,title,route_key,sort_order,enabled,#{actor},#{actor} FROM nw_foundation_navigation_nodes WHERE owner_key='tenant_template' ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_foundation_navigation_owners WHERE owner_key=#{owner})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_foundation_navigation_owners(owner_key,tenant_id) VALUES(#{owner},CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint)) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT code,parent_code,title,route_key,sort_order,enabled,revision FROM nw_foundation_navigation_nodes WHERE owner_key=#{owner} ORDER BY sort_order,code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_foundation_navigation_nodes(owner_key,tenant_id,code,parent_code,title,route_key,sort_order,enabled,created_by,updated_by) VALUES(#{owner},CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint),#{command.code},#{command.parentCode},#{command.title},#{command.routeKey},#{command.sortOrder},#{command.enabled},#{actor},#{actor}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_foundation_navigation_nodes SET parent_code=#{command.parentCode},title=#{command.title},route_key=#{command.routeKey},sort_order=#{command.sortOrder},enabled=#{command.enabled},revision=revision+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp(),updated_by=#{actor} WHERE owner_key=#{owner} AND code=#{command.code} AND revision=#{command.expectedRevision}
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM nw_foundation_navigation_nodes WHERE owner_key=#{owner} AND parent_code=#{code}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM nw_foundation_navigation_nodes WHERE owner_key=#{owner} AND code=#{command.code} AND revision=#{command.expectedRevision}
